display.purpose: The single page headline; second sentence may be gold on its own line.

headline.purpose: One short plain-sentence heading per chapter.

readout.purpose: Current phase name under the live Moon, always Nova Cyan.

body.purpose: All reading text; chapter paragraphs capped at 36em.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels and legends, nav links, chips.

meta.purpose: Facts line, spec rows, dates, captions, counters; tabular numerals.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Real game screenshots floating over the sky.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Inputs on keyboard focus, paired with a gold border.

shadows.name: phase-ring
shadows.purpose: The active phase in the eight-phase dial.

shadows.name: glass
shadows.purpose: Pinned bars only: the header and the phone Moon strip (0.9 alpha).

shadows.name: moonlit-panel
shadows.purpose: The Windows download panel; opacity follows the Moon's lit fraction squared.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Entrances: hero rise, chapter copy, fresh review.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Presses, screenshot clip reveal, phase dial scale, skip link.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour and border changes on hover and selection.

motion.name: readout-swap
motion.purpose: Phase name and fact change under the Moon.

motion.name: chapter-arrive
motion.purpose: Chapter heading and copy rise from 0.35 opacity as the Moon reaches them.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: One authored entrance for the opening chapter.

motion.name: shot-reveal
motion.purpose: Screenshots reveal top-down on entering view.

motion.name: moon-follow
motion.purpose: The live Moon eases to the in-view chapter's day; snaps under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold action per view: Download for Windows, or the form submit.
components.html: Download for Windows
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font: 800 1rem/1 Nunito, 'Noto Sans SC', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #ffd36b); color: var(--accent-ink, #1b1530); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffdc84; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffd36b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Text Button

components.html: Play online
components.css: .ds-btn-text { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 8px; color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); font: 800 1rem/1 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-text svg { width: 0.95em; height: 0.95em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.75; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-btn-text:hover { color: var(--accent, #ffd36b); } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffd36b); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled input on a translucent night fill; gold border and halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-field label { color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); font: 800 0.9rem/1.3 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgba(214,219,255,0.22)); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(9,11,31,0.55); color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Nunito Text', Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--accent, #ffd36b); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgba(214,219,255,0.32); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #ffd36b); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,211,107,0.18); }

components.name: Choice Pills

components.css: .ds-pills { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-pills label { position: relative; } .ds-pills input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; } .ds-pills span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong, rgba(214,219,255,0.22)); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #c8cbe8); font: 700 0.9rem/1 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-pills span:hover { color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); } .ds-pills input:checked + span { background: rgba(255,211,107,0.14); border-color: rgba(255,211,107,0.6); color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); } .ds-pills input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffd36b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(214,219,255,0.12)); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-2, #191d45); display: grid; gap: 16px; transition: border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; border-radius: inherit; background: radial-gradient(80% 120% at 0% 0%, rgba(255,211,107,0.16), transparent 70%); } .ds-panel:hover { border-color: var(--hairline-strong, rgba(214,219,255,0.22)); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); font: 800 1.1rem/1.3 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-spec { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 10px; } .ds-spec div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(214,219,255,0.12)); } .ds-spec dt { color: var(--ink-muted, #8a8eb6); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-spec dd { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-readout { width: min(100%, 440px); text-align: center; } .ds-readout p { margin: 0; } .ds-day { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; font: 800 0.95rem/1 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--ink-strong, #f5f3ff); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-lit { color: var(--ink-muted, #8a8eb6); font-weight: 700; } .ds-phase { margin-top: 8px !important; font: 900 2rem/1.1 Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--cyan, #8fe3ff); letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-fact { margin-top: 10px !important; color: var(--ink-muted, #8a8eb6); font: 400 0.95rem/1.55 'Nunito Text', Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-dial { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 18px; } .ds-dial button { width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #e9e4d6, #8a8578); opacity: 0.55; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms ease, transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-dial button:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-dial button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ffd36b); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-dial button[aria-current='true'] { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.18); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #090b1f, 0 0 0 3.5px #ffd36b; } .ds-dial button:active { transform: scale(0.92); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a night sky that teaches. A live, photoreal Moon (NASA LRO colour map, Lommel-Seeliger shading, earthshine on the dark limb) is the only illustration, and it changes phase as the visitor moves through the page, so reading the page is the lesson the game teaches. Everything else steps back: deep indigo ground, hairline panels, real game screenshots without device chrome, and the game's own rounded Nunito set heavy for display.

The palette is the game's: night-sky indigo, moonlight gold, Nova's cyan. Gold is light, so it lands only where the page wants a hand to move (the primary download) and where the Moon is (the active phase). Cyan is the instrument colour and appears only in the phase readout. The mood is calm, clear and a little playful: a parent should feel reassured by plain facts; a ten-year-old should still feel the sky.

Density is low. Chapters are tall, single-column on the right, with generous vertical air between them; the left column holds the Moon pinned at a steady size. On phones the Moon becomes a slim pinned strip under the header so the month keeps turning while the content scrolls.
keyCharacteristics: One dark indigo ground with a single faint cyan radial; no section background changes.
The live Moon is the hero and the only illustration; proof is real screenshots.
Gold is rationed to the primary action and the active phase.
Hairline borders and tonal surfaces carry structure; shadows are reserved for things that float.
Nunito at 800-900 for every heading, label and control; Nunito Text 400/600 for reading.
Motion follows the Moon: eased, unhurried, and fully disabled under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Moonlight Rule
rules.body: Gold is light, not decoration. It appears on the primary action, the active phase, focus, and the one panel the Moon lights. If a screen has two gold fills competing, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Cyan belongs to the Moon readout. It never colours a button, link, heading or border.

rules.name: The Scoped Signal Rule
rules.body: Rose exists only inside reviews and green only for reassurance (safety facts, success). Neither becomes a general accent.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Nunito heavy for anything you scan or press; Nunito Text for anything you read. Never set a paragraph in 800, never set a button in 400.

rules.name: The Real Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every version, size, count, date and day number uses tabular numerals so live values from the release feed never shift the layout.

rules.name: The Pinned Sky Rule
rules.body: The Moon never scrolls away. On every width some form of it stays pinned and keeps reporting the day and phase.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Panels are flat and outlined. A shadow means the object floats over the sky (a screenshot, the main action), never that a card is important.

dos: **Do** keep the page on one indigo ground (#090b1f) and build hierarchy with Deep Orbit and High Orbit surfaces plus 1px hairlines.
**Do** spend gold only on the primary action, the active phase, focus and the moonlit download panel.
**Do** keep cyan inside the Moon readout.
**Do** set headings, buttons and labels in Nunito 800-900 and reading text in Nunito Text 400/600.
**Do** make every control a pill at least 40px tall (48px for buttons) with a visible 2px gold focus outline.
**Do** use tabular numerals for every version, size, date, count and day.
**Do** show the real game: native-aspect screenshots, 12px corners, the Float shadow, no device chrome.
**Do** ease motion with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) or cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), keep presses at 120ms, and turn every entrance, reveal and swap off under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: **Don't** introduce a light theme or alternate section backgrounds; the sky is continuous.
**Don't** use rose or green outside reviews and reassurance.
**Don't** add illustrations, stock imagery or device mockups; the Moon and real screenshots are the only pictures.
**Don't** put shadows on panels or cards to signal importance.
**Don't** invent ratings, counts or testimonials to fill an empty state; empty states say so plainly.
**Don't** give hover effects to touch devices; hover rules sit behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
